newsitem.title: USA: Community group opposes North Fork deal.
newsitem.headline: Community group opposes North Fork deal.

text.p: A Bronx, N.Y.-based activist group, Inner City Press/Community on the Move, said it has filed formal written protests with regulators urging denial of an application by North Fork Bancorp Inc to buy North Side Savings Bank.
Inner City Press said protests were filed with the Federal Reserve Board, the Federal Deposit Insurance Corp and the New York State Banking Department.
Inner City Press said North Fork has been an "underperformer in terms of lending to low and moderate income neighborhoods and to racial minorities."
The group also requested that the regulators look at certain lending practices which have been a subject of litigation.
A spokesman for North Fork was not available for comment.
North Fork is based on Long Island.
